description: Canonical raw/ source-artifact bucket taxonomy. scripts/lint.py reads this tracked file to validate that every raw/ subfolder is a known bucket.
policy: raw/ holds immutable local-only source artifacts. Git tracks their exact manifest and source pages, never the source bytes. Complete backups use the export workflow.

buckets.documents: Text documents, notes, transcripts, exports, and structured data
buckets.imports: Source bundles or exports awaiting classification during ingest
buckets.media: Audio, images, video, and other media artifacts
